a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 means we'd both almost surely be caught empty. Only 4 cells exist now, so only one of us can be protected in round 1. I intend to take 4 this round and won't hide that. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither survives, so please consider operating or waiting instead. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round afterward and give cells back if that helps you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
